title: Generative AI Market Surges to $890.59 billion by 2032 | CAGR 43.4%
snippet:

title: Generative AI Market Poised to Reach $2.3 Trillion by 2032 as Agentic Systems Proliferate and Infrastructure Demand Surges, According to Bloomberg Intelligence | Press | Bloomberg LP
snippet:
June 04, 2026

NEW YORK, June 4, 2026 — New research from Bloomberg Intelligence (BI) finds that generative AI is poised to be a $2.3 trillion market by 2032, representing 22% of total technology spending across hardware, software, services and adjacent categories, as agentic systems move from experimentation into scaled enterprise deployment and hyperscaler capital expenditures approach $750 billion in 2026 alone. [...] The new forecast in the _Generative AI 2026 Outlook_ marks a $500 billion increase from BI’s prior forecast of $1.8 trillion published in March 2025, driven by accelerating token consumption, the rapid expansion of coding and customer service agents, and a faster-than-anticipated shift in compute workloads from training to inference.
